constraints.name: forced_container_actions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((resolved_at IS NULL) AND (resolved_by IS NULL) AND (external_reference IS NULL)) OR ((resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(external_reference)) >= 3))))

constraints.name: iso_report_types_category_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['20 DV'::text, '40 DV ST'::text, '40 DV HC'::text, '45 DV'::text, 'FRIGO 20'::text, 'FRIGO 40'::text, 'OT&FL&HP&CT'::text])))

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: transport_orders_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((client_order_reference IS NULL) OR (client_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: gate_visit_entry_payload
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((entry_kind = 'loaded'::text) AND (container_number IS NOT NULL)) OR ((entry_kind = 'empty'::text) AND (booking_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: truck_visits_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((exited_at IS NULL) OR ((engin_at IS NOT NULL) AND (canceled_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: truck_visits_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((canceled_at IS NULL) OR ((exited_at IS NULL) AND (length(btrim(cancel_reason)) > 0))))

constraints.name: user_roles_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
